q: Which channel brings us the most repeat customers?
answer:
By order date for Tilting Heads this month (2026-10-01–2026-10-28): Instagram feed (ig_feed) brought the most repeat customers — 88 — followed by organic (72) and Facebook feed (fb_feed) with 27.

- Top channels: ig_feed 88 repeat customers, organic 72, fb_feed 27 — these three account for the bulk of repeat buyers this month.
- Why it matters: channels that drive repeat buyers are a good place to focus retention offers or reactivation creatives; organic and ig_feed together delivered 160 repeat customers.
Worth checking: break this by campaign within ig_feed and fb_feed to see which campaigns produce repeat buyers.
